matched_queries: Employer responsibilities and worker rights: Seafarer employment agreements, pay, hours, rest, welfare and employment conditions aboard ships.
Discover UK employment guidance for Seafarers Charter. Task relevance is separate from current law, commencement and a need to edit.

passages.quote:
Seafarers’ employment contracts are covered by the Maritime Labour Convention (MLC) 2006.

Working time regulations

All seafarers on seagoing ships are entitled to:

a minimum of 10 hours’ rest in any 24 hour period

77 hours rest in any 7 day period

at least 4 weeks’ paid annual leave

Read the Merchant Shipping Regulations 2002 for more information.
